notes: This collection stores canonical regulation text only, not source-channel wrapper notices.
Provenance must preserve source_notice_ids and explicitly separate source_notice_document_id from semantic_owner_document_id when promotion originates from internal_notice.
The target collection is source-channel-agnostic: future canonical regulation sources may promote into the same collection.
The target contract uses regulation_work_title for document identity inputs and regulation_display_title for presentation.
The target display title preserves full edition semantics such as 2026版 or 2026年修订; it does not collapse an edition to a bare year token.
A future materializer must preserve source_title_literal as source-facing metadata.
No active runtime currently materializes or promotes this profile.
